headline: Cybersecurity chiefs say AI systems built to defend computer networks on their own are not yet ready for full use, the Wall Street Journal reports.
score_reason: Pool score kept: relevant view from security leaders, but only the headline could be checked, so it stays on the watchlist.
importance_line: Companies thinking of handing network defence to autonomous AI may be advised to keep people in the loop for now, but the reasons given and how many officials hold this view are not known from the headline alone.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that cybersecurity chiefs say AI systems designed to defend computer networks autonomously are not yet ready for widespread use.
notes: Headline only: WSJ Pro paywall (HTTP 401) and no other outlet found.
